connector.name: TickerDB
connector.registryDescription: Pre-computed market data that improves agent reasoning, reduces token usage, and replaces pipelines.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.tickerdb.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package tickerdb-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.tickerdb. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.
